spec.title: vibevm.org site package
spec.p: This package is the Qwik application behind vibevm.org and the globally installable `vibevm-doc` command. Its manifest, installer options and launch points live in `vibe.toml`; `README.md` explains how the site is built, served and installed. The local-site launcher and its install recipes live in `tooling/local-site/`; `tools/floor.mjs` runs the package's discipline floor.

Before changing the package, read `vibe.toml` and `README.md`. Keep platform, architecture, installer, launcher and public-command names package-authored. Keep install recipes relocatable: they write into `$VIBE_OUT` and never bake an absolute path in. Do not claim a Windows or macOS installation has passed without running it on that host.
